boundaries.description: Actual parent/child TCP transfers preserve Fake-IP session authority and centralized cancellation.
Both generations retain live TLS/WebSocket streams, original CA/custom roots and one contiguous resident audit sequence.
Authenticated SSH channels continue across worker switch using unchanged MITM host identity.
Four retained old workers keep all streams; extra prepare is refused and natural drain releases capacity.
Control disconnection preserves granted streams, normal EOF and central revocation; final OS exit releases parent leases.
Confirmed candidate crash permits rollback of future dispatch while prior generation stream survives.
A source child that never reads large bootstrap cannot escape the whole-phase 30s send deadline.
A Booted child that stops consuming controls is quarantined by the 30s health deadline and retired.
With zero target Hosts, bad native ABI cannot publish global stable deployment or change installed target/active worker.
Real Unix descriptor exhaustion during granted probe creation marks the original shared socket complete without relying on a Finished frame.
Control loss immediately releases ungranted offer claims, preserves granted cancellation watchers, and remains idempotent.
Native boolean decoder accepts the exact supported one-byte BOOLEAN and four-byte DWORD representations, ignores bytes outside optlen, and rejects every unsupported length.
